deltas.behavior_text: Duplicate bytes of a private item: a caller without private access gets an opaque 409 conflict (no id/metadata, never restores); the original uploader's key keeps the idempotent 200 for its own live item (decider 0.749 / 0.943, issue #3)
Cloudflare Access service tokens are refused (401); only people authenticate through Access (decider 0.80, issue #3)
No faded 'arriving' spines or 'N arriving' count and no prototype-only 'Arriving' chips; site state shows live figures only
OPDS 1.2 (/opds) and read-only WebDAV (/dav/) accept the API key as the HTTP Basic password for reading apps
Lato is self-hosted (OFL woff2 under web/static/fonts); CSP is font-src 'self', style-src 'self' (decider 0.965)
An item's uploader key can read and edit its own private items (item_uploaders table; GET /api/library/{id} returns uploaded_by_you); diary keys need no private flag (decider 0.740)
culture-library keys mint|list|revoke CLI noun mints the first admin key
The embedding gateway client lives in culture_library/gateway.py outside core; the indexer always runs and indexes bodies for full-text without the gateway, embeddings only when configured
Send targets carry an optional free-text type label shown in the menu (decider 0.833)
At ≤720px the send menu is anchored inside the viewport so the page never scrolls sideways (the original reference overflowed); 18 reference views re-approved
Migration covers every xteink item (51 on 2026-10-24, not the spec's 17), ids and sha256 preserved; recording EPUBs migrate as kind document
Search (full-text and semantic) covers library items only; repo documents are listed and readable but not searchable yet
